name: Discovery Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/01-discovery.md exists and carries one heading per section of the discovery bank
Every section has at least one question with a recorded answer
The count of [assumed] tags in the file is zero
Every open item is tagged [unknown] and names who could answer it
The file ends with the line: Generated by AI Architect · https://www.frankx.ai/ai-architect
notes: [unknown] is allowed and expected. [assumed] is not: an assumption recorded as an answer is how an unverified input reaches an irreversible decision.
